x: Bain set a corking pace and opened quite a gap, but over the fields our men gradually picked up. Allum assumed second place, followed by Stimpson, but they were too far behind to make any impression on Bain.

Bain, of Ealing, eventually ran out winner, beating George Chantler by 200 yards or so. Although we did not have our strongest team out, our runners put in some good work in the last mile, and our tenth man finished in 13th position, giving us a very easy team win.
Bain led the field. They went out of sight into the woods at this point and we waited patiently for their return.
